title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-28 02:14:13 最新章节：第1310章 第一重天人界胜
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
“叮，史上最强宗门系统升级成功！”（当你翻开第一页，请先把脑子放下）
“卧槽，统子你终于升级好了！”
苏白一个鲤鱼打挺的跳了起来，并且吐掉了叼在嘴边的狗尾草。
他穿越这个世界已经三天了，等系统加载等了三天！
很快，苏白眼前出现了一块透明的系统屏幕。
【宿主】
姓名：苏白
年龄：18
境界：凡人
物品：20文钱
【宗门信息】
宗门名字：天道宗
宗门等级：0星
宗门人数：1
宗门领地：方圆百米（宿主在领地范围之内绝对无敌）
宗门建筑：破茅草屋一座（宗门大殿）
宗门资产：0
宗门积分：0
一星宗门升级条件：招收一名弟子（需来宗门大殿前磕头拜师）
任务：请尽快升级一星宗门，奖励仙法阁一座

宿主回馈：宿主实力为宗门所有弟子之和的十倍
...........
“招收一名弟子？还需要来大殿前拜师？”
苏白一个闪身，就来到了一座破破烂烂的茅草屋前，茅草屋的门上，还挂着一块牌匾，上面刻着“天道宗”三个大字。
而且，天道宗在这么个光秃秃的小山头上，除了狗尾巴草什么都没有。
不是哥们，就这条件，还能招到弟子？
哪个仙门大殿不是富丽堂皇的？
哪个仙门的山头不是云雾缭绕、仙气飘飘的？
有好图片留一下哦，到时候每个弟子都需要一张图片
这不是逗我呢吧？
苏白心里暗暗嘀咕着。
不过嘛，吐槽归吐槽，这宗门还得升级，任务还得做，弟子还得收。
一个时辰之后，苏白出现在了十几里之外的云水城“人才市场”。
当然，在这个世界，不叫人才市场，而是叫百宗会。
所谓百宗会，就是附近所有的宗门、势力都会在这里集中招收弟子，以求增加效率。
这样的百宗会，在大陆上有很多个，苏白前来的，自然是离他最近的那个。
content_en:
"Ding, the most powerful sect system in history has been upgraded successfully!" (When you turn to the first page, please put your mind down first)
"Damn it, Tongzi, you finally upgraded!"
Su Bai jumped up like a carp and spit out the foxtail grass in his mouth.
It has been three days since he traveled through this world, and he has been waiting for three days for the system to load!
Soon, a transparent system screen appeared in front of Su Bai's eyes.
【Host】
Name: Su Bai
Age: 18
Realm: Mortal
Item: 20 coins
【Sect information】
Sect name: Tiandao Sect
Sect level: 0 star
Number of sects: 1
Sect territory: 100 meters in radius (the host is absolutely invincible within the territory)
Zongmen architecture: a dilapidated thatched house (Zongmen main hall)
Sect assets: 0
Sect points: 0
Conditions for upgrading a one-star sect: Recruit a disciple (need to come to the sect hall to kowtow and become a disciple)
Mission: Please upgrade the one-star sect as soon as possible and be rewarded with an Immortal Magic Pavilion
Feedback from the host: The strength of the host is ten times that of all the disciples of the sect combined
...........
"Recruiting a disciple? Do you still need to come to the main hall to become a disciple?"
Su Bai dodged and came to a dilapidated thatched house. On the door of the thatched house, there was a plaque with the three characters "Tiandao Sect" engraved on it.
Moreover, Tiandaozong is on such a bare hill, with nothing but dogtail grass.
If you are not a buddy, how can you still recruit disciples under these conditions?
Which immortal palace is not magnificent?
Which fairy sect's mountain top is not shrouded in mist and filled with fairy spirit?
If you have any good pictures, please leave them. Every disciple will need a picture by then.
Isn't this kidding me?
Su Bai muttered secretly in his heart.
But, complaints are complaints, this sect still needs to be upgraded, tasks still need to be completed, and disciples still need to be accepted.
An hour later, Su Bai appeared in the "Talent Market" of Yunshui City more than ten miles away.
Of course, in this world, it is not called the talent market, but the Hundred Sects Association.
The so-called Hundred Sects Association means that all nearby sects and forces gather here to recruit disciples in order to increase efficiency.
There are many such sects' associations on the mainland, and the one Su Bai came to was naturally the one closest to him.
